how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-undercity-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:232:obj:0: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:232:details:0: The Royal Apothecary Society needs your assistance. Listen closely, and both of us may profit from my plan.
rows.quest:232:details:1: BApothecary Keever in the next room may be... touched... but his research does potentially bear fruit if it were pursued by a clever researcher. Fortunately, I am such a researcher. I want you to take this purchase order to Alessandro Luca, the proprietor of Blue Moon Odds and Ends; he'll give you a testing kit. When you have it, bring it back to me and I'll outline your task in detail.
rows.quest:232:completion:0: Ah, Zinge needs a kit, does she? It saddens me that Zinge does not choose to grace myself with her sweet presence.
rows.quest:232:completion:1: BVery well, let me procure a kit for you.
rows.quest:238:obj:0: Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:238:details:0: The kit is ready, ⟦1⟧. No doubt that Apothecary Zinge will want this as soon as possible. Take it to her without delay, and let her know that I will add the cost of the kit to the Society's tab. Also, please extend to her my warmest salutations.
rows.quest:238:details:1: BWell, don't just stand there. Such is the life of a simple courier, yes?
rows.quest:238:completion:0: Good - it pleases me to be working with someone who takes pride in not wasting my time.
rows.quest:238:completion:1: BAfter I make some adjustments to this kit, you'll be ready to head out into the field. You'll be using it to collect some vital data to the task at hand.
rows.quest:238:completion:2: BIt will take just a moment for me to finish the modifications. While you are waiting, you should probably start thinking about what you'd like to bring to the desert with you.
rows.quest:357:obj:0: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:357:details:0: There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north. Although he is a free-willed ⟦E2⟧, he believes all other Undead are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.
rows.quest:357:details:1: BBut because he is ⟦E2⟧, the Queen will want him. And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.
rows.quest:357:details:2: BTo discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook. Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.
rows.quest:357:completion:0: Very good, ⟦2⟧. I will study this book and determine the identity of that lich. You have served your Queen well.
rows.quest:357:completion:1: B<Bethor opens the book and stares intently at its glowing pages...>
rows.quest:357:completion:2: BAstonishing! The book you retrieved belongs to no one other than Gunther Arcanus!
rows.quest:357:completion:3: BGunther was a skilled Necromancer in life; he and I were friends and comrades-in-arms, before the Plague. And judging from his book he has grown even more powerful in death.
rows.quest:357:completion:4: BHis skills would be a great boon to us.
rows.quest:495:obj:0: Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:495:details:0: Mug'Thol and his ogre warband was sent to Alterac to retrieve the Crown of Will for Lady Sylvanas. Unfortunately, instead of returning it, the idiot decided to try it on... I suppose ogres can't resist anything bright and shiny.
rows.quest:495:details:1: BHis bumbling actions have become something of a problem, however. The Crown of Will enabled him to resist the possession placed upon him to serve Lady Sylvanas.
rows.quest:495:details:2: BThe Dark Lady wants an example made, travel to Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad and report to Melisara, my lieutenant.
rows.quest:495:completion:0: You were sent by Shalindra? Very well then, you'll find I don't waste much time with idle chatter.
rows.quest:495:completion:1: BMug'Thol is an irritant, and we will deal with him quickly, thoroughly, and without incident.
rows.quest:736:obj:0: Bring the items on Bel'dugur's Note to Keeper Bel'dugur in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:736:details:0: You need Yagyin's Digest? Your plan, then, is to gather another flock? Of course it is...and of course I will help you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:736:details:1: BBut you must help me too.
rows.quest:736:details:2: BI require three items of power. Bring me these and the digest will be yours.
rows.quest:736:details:3: BI cannot utter the names of these items, but I will write them down.
rows.quest:736:details:4: BGet me the items on this list. If you can do that, then you are truly worthy of opening your own chapter of our order.
rows.quest:736:completion:0: I am impressed! You possess great skill, or great fortune, to have gained these relics. Either way, you are an asset to us.
rows.quest:864:obj:0: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:864:details:0: "Here you go, the power source is safely removed and the data is preserved. Well, safe journeys and all that. ⟦E4⟧ the nefarious science experiment worked out for you and all."
rows.quest:864:details:1: BThe goblin turns away from you to attend to the demands of the Gadgetzan Water Company. You secure the sealed testing kit for the journey back to the ⟦E1⟧. Apothecary Zinge waits for you and the sealed field testing kit there.
rows.quest:864:completion:0: I will analyze this data immediately. Perhaps Keever's insanity will prove to be my genius after all.
rows.quest:864:completion:1: BAs for you... you are useful to me, and I reward quite well those who remain useful. Take this item, this coin, and most importantly my thanks along with them.
rows.quest:864:completion:2: BCheck back with me from time to time - I wager that our working together on this project is not at an end.
rows.quest:1004:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E5⟧ Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of ⟦E6⟧ about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1004:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of ⟦E7⟧! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of ⟦E8⟧ and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
rows.quest:1004:details:2: BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch ⟦E5⟧ Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder's Rise of ⟦E6⟧ for more information!
rows.quest:1004:completion:1: BI am pleased to see the likes of you taking an interest in the well being of nature; tales of your mighty deeds precede you, and you are welcomed here. Seeing you before me instills the feeling of confidence that the Cenarion Circle will get the proper aid it needs.
rows.quest:1004:completion:2: BOur connection with the Cenarion Circle in ⟦E9⟧ transcends racial and political divides. Remember this as you work on behalf of the Circle, and you will do well.
rows.quest:1164:obj:0: Bring Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie's Heads to Genavie Callow in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1164:details:0: The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. ⟦E2⟧ indeed!
rows.quest:1164:details:1: BMy family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.
rows.quest:1164:details:2: BI don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!
rows.quest:1164:details:3: BKill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
rows.quest:1164:completion:0: You stand before me as a figure of vengeance, and I bow down before you in thanks.
rows.quest:1164:completion:1: BWith that cow's death, and knowing that their seed will no longer spread over the face of ⟦E10⟧, I can put my energy into something more lucrative. I hope you looted their farmstead after you finished them off.
rows.quest:1358:obj:0: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1358:details:0: A colleague in ⟦E7⟧, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of ⟦E7⟧. He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.
rows.quest:1358:details:1: BHelbrim is stationed in the ⟦E11⟧, in a village known as the Crossroads. To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of ⟦E12⟧, then travel south, by foot, to ⟦E13⟧. Head west into the ⟦E11⟧, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
rows.quest:1358:completion:0: Ah, very good. If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.
rows.quest:1358:completion:1: BThis is a welcome delivery, ⟦5⟧. Your reward is well earned.
rows.quest:1359:obj:0: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1359:details:0: The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens. There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!
rows.quest:1359:details:1: BIt's quite incredible, and we must study it further. I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired. Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge. You will find her in our headquarters in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1359:completion:0: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke. I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.
rows.quest:2995:obj:0: Oran Snakewrithe in ⟦E1⟧ wants you to travel to the Hinterlands and burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.
rows.quest:2995:details:0: The Quel'Danil Lodge is a center of communication for the high elves of the Hinterlands. Their ambassadors are working to establish relationships with other races, with whom they share their knowledge of the Witherbark trolls that inhabit the area in the southern Hinterlands. All of the documents regarding the communications are kept at the lodge.
rows.quest:2995:details:1: BWe don't need the Highvale building alliances with others, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:2995:details:2: BDestroy the Highvale documents. We need to burn their lines of communication... literally.
rows.quest:2995:completion:0: Perfect, ⟦7⟧. While the Highvale work to recover their lost information, we will be able to seal off the lines even further...
rows.quest:3568:obj:0: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in ⟦E14⟧ before returning to Chemist Cuely.
rows.quest:3568:details:0: See that tauren behind me--the one who looks like she's going to be ill at any moment? She was in ⟦E14⟧ recently. She claims she was wounded by some naga while making her way through the Ruins of Eldarath.
rows.quest:3568:details:1: BAfter fighting off a few of them, she took a break on the beach and drank from one of the tide pools. Now she's feeling nauseous... among other things.
rows.quest:3568:details:2: BI'd like to find out what she drank. Take this box, in it are some empty vials I labeled. Fill each at different pools and come back.
rows.quest:3568:completion:0: Wonderful. You're back before she died. Good, good.
rows.quest:3568:completion:1: BLet's get started on this then, shall we?
rows.quest:3568:completion:2: BI've been studying her symptoms for some time now, and it's quite ugly. I'm surprised she's still standing. She's vomited three or four times all over the place... quite a pleasant odor.
rows.quest:3568:completion:3: BGive me just a moment to put something together to test on our... friend.
rows.quest:3569:obj:0: Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:3569:details:0: Give this to Thersa. Perhaps it will cure her... perhaps not. We really won't know until after she drinks it.
rows.quest:3569:completion:0: Chemist Cuely has been very accommodating... disturbingly so. But if he says this will help me, then I have no other choice. I don't have time to find any other solution. I've already spoken to priests and shamans, none of which could help me.
rows.quest:3569:completion:1: BLet us hope that the Earthmother watches over my spirit.
rows.quest:3570:completion:0: I never dreamed the elixir would take hold that quickly. Thank you, ⟦8⟧. I will get to work on the rest of these samples right away. I'm sure they'll be usable by the Lady Sylvanas and the ⟦E2⟧ soon enough.
rows.quest:3784:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E5⟧ Hamuul Runetotem in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:3784:details:0: Excuse me ⟦9⟧, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.
rows.quest:3784:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle in ⟦E6⟧ is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.
rows.quest:3784:details:2: BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within ⟦E6⟧ proper.
rows.quest:3784:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦10⟧; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research. There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous. Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.
rows.quest:4293:obj:0: Gather ⟦E15⟧ Slime Samples from any of the slimes in ⟦E15⟧. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in ⟦E1⟧, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted ⟦E15⟧ Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.
rows.quest:4293:details:0: ⟦E15⟧ is a forest far north of the ⟦E11⟧, even farther than ⟦E16⟧. There, slimes are found all around pools of water blessed by the touch of Fel. The Scourge decimated the area with attacks of Infernals and other demonic magics--the slimes supposedly crept up through the earth during these attacks.
rows.quest:4293:details:1: BGather samples of ⟦E15⟧ slimes and we will use the testing equipment next to me to create a control group for our tests against other samples you gather.
rows.quest:4293:completion:0: Ah, excellent. These samples will do nicely. I thank you for your help.
rows.quest:4293:completion:1: BOnce we've gathered all the samples of slimes, we'll be able to determine more. I am beginning to suspect that Lady Sylvanas' hunch was not only correct, but more insightful than even she could have predicted. These samples are very interesting. Just seeing how they've reacted with my compounds... hmm, yes, we'll definitely need to investigate further.
rows.quest:4294:obj:0: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in ⟦E17⟧. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in ⟦E1⟧, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.
rows.quest:4294:details:0: Have you heard of the ⟦E17⟧, ⟦11⟧? It is near the ⟦E8⟧ desert, and it is a magnificent place: lush, vibrant, full of creatures and plant life.
rows.quest:4294:details:1: BIt is there you must go. Word has reached me that the place seems completely untainted by outside hands. Explorers are just now discovering its secrets.
rows.quest:4294:details:2: BI would like to test the slimes or oozes there. If it is true--that they are uncorrupt--then I would like to see how such creatures have evolved.
rows.quest:4294:completion:0: Truly amazing, ⟦12⟧. This ⟦E17⟧ is holding many more secrets than I expected. I wonder what else we will discover as we test further.
rows.quest:4294:completion:1: BSimply amazing... look at the purity of these samples. Hmm, I wonder what it could mean. They seem to be elemental in nature, but... something more. They remind me of... of the Old Gods. We've found traces of them throughout ⟦E10⟧, and now I wonder if these creatures aren't related to them somehow.
rows.quest:4294:completion:2: BWe shall have to test further.
rows.quest:4642:obj:0: Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:4642:details:0: Here is some encased ooze created from the ⟦E15⟧ samples you recovered. Take the case to ⟦E17⟧ and find a pure ooze... the primal variety will do nicely. When you get close enough, release the ooze in the case, and let us see what the two think of one another.
rows.quest:4642:details:1: BAfter the experiment concludes, bring me a sample of whatever is left over. I will await you here in the Apothecarium.
rows.quest:4642:completion:0: Oh, most excellent, ⟦13⟧. This is most excellent.
rows.quest:4642:completion:1: BSuch a tale. Who would have thought the two would interact with one another in such a way... I will have to spend more time looking at the environmental issues that cause changes in these creatures.
rows.quest:4642:completion:2: BI will continue my research for now. Perhaps we will speak again soon. Until then, I wish you well.
rows.quest:5049:obj:0: Find Jeremiah Payson in the ⟦E1⟧ and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.
rows.quest:5049:details:0: From the evidence I am able to muster, the person you seek - and the intended recipient of the parcel - is Jeremiah Payson, the ⟦E1⟧ cockroach vendor.
rows.quest:5049:details:1: BI've always been of the opinion that it takes a special gift to sell... cockroaches. No doubt you are on quite the epic sojourn now, mighty ⟦14⟧. I will leave you to your world-shaping endeavors. Allow me, however, to be a part of your magnum opus and reveal that he is located near the bank, suitably groveling under one of the walkways.
rows.quest:5049:completion:0: I haven't used that name in years... but yes, at one point in my life - before this glorious unlife - that was my last name.
rows.quest:5049:completion:1: BYou claim to have known my sister... or rather, have recently spoken to my sister.
rows.quest:5049:completion:4: BYou know, if my bones weren't already brittle enough, I'd be tempted to break my foot off on your posterior. You're quite the vulture, aren't you?
rows.quest:5049:completion:5: B What... you have a package for me from my sister?
rows.quest:5961:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E18⟧ Blightcaller in the ⟦E19⟧. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.⟦15⟧
rows.quest:5961:details:0: It pleases me greatly to see the battle hardened join our cause. Our numbers grow in size and strength as each day passes. Perhaps you are prepared to test your mettle, ⟦16⟧?
rows.quest:5961:details:1: BAmong the first of my champions was ⟦E18⟧, now known as the Blightcaller. Few exist with more dedication or vigor amidst our ranks.
rows.quest:5961:details:2: BSeek him out in the ⟦E19⟧. He resides at the Marris Stead; occasionally roaming the decimated wastes, slaying all Scourge and ⟦E20⟧ filth that cross his path.
rows.quest:5961:completion:0: Surely the Dark Lady does not believe you worthy to meet her champion. You are here to feed my hounds, yes? There could be no other reason for this interruption.
rows.quest:7813:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦17⟧!
rows.quest:7814:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦18⟧!
rows.quest:7817:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦19⟧!
rows.quest:7818:completion:0: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.
rows.quest:7818:completion:1: BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!
